mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the circulation to the body was most worthwhile: the planned insets link blood supply, respiratory drive and fluid accumulation when return is inadequate.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate collecting-duct and venous-junction combinations felt somewhat repetitive, though each made a distinct part of the route visible.

surprise.text: The lymphatic entry illustration showed proteins entering alongside tissue fluid, not just water.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, although assembling the return route in several separate combinations was predictable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting the systems and seeing the consequences of inadequate fluid return was more engaging than simply assembling named structures.
